- Nominative vs oblique plural of DUMU{meš} (hammurabi-laws-170-177, review pass 2): the code writes DUMU{meš} for both cases. Decided: `mārū` (mārūša, mārūa) where it is the subject, `mārī` where accusative, genitive or after a preposition. This is already the practice of 127-140, 141-152, 153-169 (the mārum glossary entry lists both). The `say` is a grammatical normalization, not on the stele; if the owner prefers one form throughout, a global change is needed in the six parts that have mārū/mārī.
